1) When you say "residency" do they require full on‑prem (air‑gapped) or VPC customer‑managed control plane?

Appreciate the details — and congrats on the momentum here. High level from Product: we can propose a scoped MVP that reduces scope to the smallest set that meets Procurement's conditions: 
- Offer: customer‑managed VPC deployment + CMK support for keys (leveraging our existing KMS connectors)
- Isolation: routing affinity + logical namespace isolation for payment workflows (separate model variants + prefix KV scoping). This would not be physical pinning of GPUs for all traffic, but we can reserve a limited warm pool for critical routes to reduce cold starts and provide capacity SLAs.

Tradeoffs / cost: achieving full physical tenant pinning for guaranteed CPU/GPU isolation will require Dedicated capacity and longer lead time (likely multiple sprints beyond 8/15). The MVP approach results in lower initial engineering cost but will require us to include clear acceptance criteria and an audit plan (trace IDs, per‑token audit logs, retention policy).

Requested from Sales/Customer: 
- Confirm the acceptance criteria SummitBank will sign against (audit log retention window, example replay drill, latency SLOs for critical APIs).
- Clear traffic profile (thank you Daniel — that helps).
- Explicit approval to convert this to a committed Dedicated contract if we need physical pinning down the line (we'll estimate delta pricing).

If Sales confirms the acceptance criteria and gives Product a go, Jordan and I will scope an engineering plan and provide a story‑level breakdown by 6/25. We can also fast‑track a minimal runbook and compliance packet for procurement.

I will create a short Jira epic and link it here once we have go‑ahead.
